# SYMBOLS.md — exported-symbol parity (C `libmujs.so` vs Rust `libmujs.so`)

Generated mechanically with `nm -D --defined-only` on both shared objects
(`c_src/build/libmujs.so` and `target/debug/libmujs.so`).

## Totals

| | count |
|---|---|
| symbols exported by C `.so` | 237 |
| symbols exported by Rust `.so` | 237 |
| **C symbols MISSING from Rust `.so`** | **0** |
| extra symbols only in Rust `.so` | 0 |
| undefined **non-libc** symbols in Rust `.so` | **0** |

Every undefined entry in the Rust `.so` is a libc / libgcc import
(`malloc`, `realloc`, `memcpy`, `memset`, `_setjmp`, `longjmp`, `pow`, `sin`,
`gmtime`, `mktime`, `snprintf`, `_Unwind_*`, ...). The C `.so` imports the same
set plus `ceil`/`floor`/`fmod`/`sqrt`/`__assert_fail`; the Rust build lowers
those four to instructions instead of libm calls.

### Note: variadic and macro-generated symbols

The 8 printf-style variadic entry points (`js_error`, `js_evalerror`,
`js_rangeerror`, `js_referenceerror`, `js_syntaxerror`, `js_typeerror`,
`js_urierror`, `jsC_error`) cannot be written as C-variadic functions in stable
Rust. They are exported from `src/lib.rs` as `#[naked]` x86-64 SysV
trampolines (`va_trampoline!`) that materialise a `va_list` and tail into the
`*_va` worker in `src/jserror.rs` / `src/jscompile.rs`. The
`js_new*error` family is generated by the `DERROR!` macro in `src/jserror.rs`.
Those are the rows whose "Rust module" column reads `lib.rs (naked va)` or
`jserror.rs (DERROR! macro)`.

## Phase D status

| check | result |
|---|---|
| C symbols missing from the Rust `.so` | **0** |
| symbols only in the Rust `.so` | **0** |
| undefined non-libc symbols in the Rust `.so` | **0** |
| feature combinations verified | **1 of 1** (no `[features]` section, no optional deps) |

The symbol diff is EMPTY in both directions: the Rust cdylib exports exactly the
same 237 names as the C build, including the 8 naked-asm variadic trampolines and
the 7 `DERROR!`-macro-generated `js_new*error` functions.

Reproduce with:

```sh
./run_tests.sh                 # builds both libs, stamps the source hash, runs 411 tests
./check_features.sh            # enumerates every feature combination and checks each
nm -D --defined-only c_src/build/libmujs.so   | awk '{print $3}' | sort -u > /tmp/c.txt
nm -D --defined-only target/debug/libmujs.so  | awk '{print $3}' | sort -u > /tmp/r.txt
comm -23 /tmp/c.txt /tmp/r.txt   # must be empty
```
